About

About HDXCLOUD

HDXCLOUD is a hosting brand that focuses on straightforward, per-GB RAM Minecraft hosting alongside a dedicated VPS / VM portal.

HDXCLOUD offers Minecraft hosting across three hardware tiers — Cheap, Budget, and Performance — with pricing expressed per GB of RAM per month. SSD storage is included with Minecraft plans, and online RAM selections are configurable up to 32 GB.

VPS and VM hosting are delivered through a separate portal at vms.hdxclouds.com, and all orders are managed through the client billing panel at billing.hdxcloud.xyz.

Documentation, terms, and policies are published at docs.hdxclouds.info.

This website intentionally avoids unverified claims — including invented uptime guarantees, fabricated customer totals, and marketing statistics that cannot be confirmed from the actual service offering.
